## Documentation hub

This page connects the HYDRA-EO project documentation with its source code,
processing pipelines and the maintained RTM-Suite manuals. Public resources
open directly in their authoritative location.

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.vbl-card}
::: pill-mini
Docs
:::

### Methodological documentation

Methodological notes, protocol documents, and technical PDFs describing the processing
pipelines, modelling assumptions, and analysis workflows developed within HYDRA-EO.

[Methods](https://github.com/CCGCAM/HYDRA-EO-workflow/blob/main/docs/METHODS.md){target="_blank"} ·
[Datasets](https://github.com/CCGCAM/HYDRA-EO-workflow/blob/main/docs/DATASETS.md){target="_blank"} ·
[Synthetic modelling module](https://github.com/CCGCAM/HYDRA-EO-workflow/blob/main/docs/SYNTHETIC_MODELING_MODULE.md){target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: pill-mini
Fields
:::
### Field manuals & protocols

Official field manuals covering disease scoring, sampling strategies, and experimental
protocols used across crop trials (e.g. olive, pistachio, potato).

[Browse project documentation](https://github.com/CCGCAM/HYDRA-EO-workflow/tree/main/docs){target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: pill-mini
ESA
:::
### Meetings & reporting

Meeting minutes, internal presentations, and ESA reporting templates supporting

[Deliverables](https://github.com/CCGCAM/HYDRA-EO-workflow/blob/main/docs/outputs/deliverables.md){target="_blank"} ·
